summary: RETEST of Sensory Shuttle OS Phase 1+2 fixes. Both reported FIXES are CONFIRMED WORKING. FIX 1 (hash-based persona override via useRouterState in RoleGate): the exact previously-failing flow — page.goto sequence /app/dispatch#demoRole=dispatcher → /app/audit#demoRole=broker_admin → /app/providers#demoRole=broker_admin → /app/facility#demoRole=facility_viewer — now renders the proper persona view on each step, with the correct 'Viewing as <role>' label and access scope, and no 'Not in this demo role' card. Audit page shows all 5 seeded rows (L-9001..L-9005, all rendered with data-testid='audit-row-<id>'). Providers page shows the Provider accountability portal. Facility page shows Appointment transportation status with the read-only Facility/Care Team Viewer persona active. FIX 2 (Evidence Packet dialog): both seeded incidents (INC-501 and INC-502) render their Evidence Packet button with data-testid='evidence-packet-btn-<id>'. Clicking evidence-packet-btn-INC-501 reliably opens a [role=dialog] with data-testid='evidence-packet-dialog-INC-501' containing all 13 required headings/values (Evidence Packet — INC-501, Ride:, Rider:, Driver:, Provider:, Filed at:, Required accommodations:, Driver confirmations:, ETA confidence timeline:, Reporter statement:, GPS ping log:, Photo evidence:, Recommended next action:) plus the 'Print evidence packet' button. REGRESSION: all iteration_1 passing items still pass — Registered Riders directory (6 rider-row-*, 3 flag-dropdown-*, flag dropdown content opens, flag-explanation-dialog opens on flag click), Rider profile /app/registered-riders/RR-1001 (heading 'Avery K.', rider-profile-flags rendered), Book Ride (all 11 spec data-testids present, react-day-picker popover opens, all 4 new appointment types Medical/Occupational Therapy/Speech Therapy/Other present alongside Therapy).

issues: Profile page shows 6 inline flag chips before the '+N more' dropdown, but the directory list collapses to only 3 inline. Spec says 'first 3 flags inline + +N more'. Inconsistent collapse threshold between list view and profile view — confirm intent.

(LOW, carry-over from iteration_1) Insurance Member ID autofill is a masked literal '•••• 4421'. Decide if masked-literal is the intended persisted value vs. raw ID rendered masked.

(LOW, carry-over from iteration_1) Group number autofills to empty placeholder while company/policy holder/auth autofill. Confirm rider profile data actually has no group number, or fix the data source.
critical_code_review_comments: RoleGate now correctly uses useRouterState({select: s => s.location.hash}) and re-derives demo persona on every router navigation, propagating to the store (and indirectly localStorage). Clean fix that also avoids the hashchange-only listener trap. Good.

DemoPersonaProvider in /app/src/lib/store.tsx still has its own readDemoRoleFromHash + hashchange listener — this is redundant with RoleGate's propagation but harmless. Consider centralizing hash-derivation in one place to remove the duplicate logic.

Note for testers: rapid page.goto across protected routes on a cold Vite dev server requires wait_for_load_state('networkidle') (or ~5s) before asserting persona; the previous iteration's 'flakiness' partly stemmed from short 2.5s waits hitting the server while JS was still compiling. The fix itself is solid — verified across two independent runs.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of in-scope retest items (FIX 1 + FIX 2 + all data-testid coverage + regression suite)

ALWAYS use page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle', timeout=20000) followed by ~2s settle before asserting on protected routes — the cold dev server compile pass can otherwise mask correct behavior as a 'persona override race'. data-testid coverage confirmed: rider-row-<id>, flag-dropdown-<id>, flag-dropdown-content-<id>, flag-<term>, flag-explanation-dialog, rider-profile-flags, book-date-picker-trigger, book-date-picker-popover, book-time-input, book-insurance-card, book-insurance-type-trigger, book-insurance-details, book-insurance-company, book-insurance-member-id, book-insurance-group, book-insurance-policy-holder, book-insurance-authorization, book-submit-btn, evidence-packet-btn-<id>, evidence-packet-dialog-<id>, audit-row-<id>. Both FIX 1 and FIX 2 verified — ready to proceed to Phase 3.
rca_of_the_issue: FIX 1: Original race was that DemoPersonaProvider only read window.location.hash on mount + hashchange events, but TanStack Router's programmatic navigation between paths that share the same SPA shell does not always fire hashchange before the route gate evaluates. Fix replaces this with useRouterState({select: s => s.location.hash}) inside RoleGate, which subscribes to every router location update and re-derives the demo persona deterministically. The hash now wins over localStorage on every navigation. Verified: dispatcher → audit(broker_admin) → providers(broker_admin) → facility(facility_viewer) all render their proper persona view. FIX 2: The Evidence Packet dialog was previously not opening because incidents were being filtered out for the wrong persona (broker_admin scope wasn't applied) — a side effect of FIX 1. With FIX 1 applied, the 2 seeded incidents (INC-501, INC-502) render under broker_admin and the dialog opens reliably with all 13 required content fields + Print button.
